name: Vertex AI Search Promoted Results
description: manages promoted/promotional items for Vertex AI Search.
project_description:
The Vertex AI Search Promoted Results module provides for the creation and management of promoted search results triggered by specific search keywords. For a given keyword, a content node can be specified as a promoted result. The promoted result will appear at the top of the search results on a Vertex AI Search custom search page.

 Background 
 This module was developed as a response to Google's recommendation that Site-Restricted JSON API clients move away from the Programmable Search Engine platform and use Vertex AI Search instead.

 Read the module background documentation for more information.

 Features 
 This module provides the following:

 
 Custom Entity to represent a promoted search result. 
 Administrative page to manage promoted search results. 
 Custom plugin for manipulating the results of a Vertex AI Search custom search page. 
 Configuration to limit the content types that may be promoted. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After the module is installed and cache is cleared, an administration page for promoted results will be available at (/admin/content/vais_promo/list).

 From this page, new promoted results can be created for specific keywords.

 Refer to the documentation on creating a promoted search result for more information.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module depends on the following Drupal module:

 
 Vertex AI Search
